Ye meri umr mohabbat ke liye thodi hai
couplets.en: Meeting you made me realize how little a lifetime is for love.

lines: Ek zara sa gham-e-dauraan ka bhi haq hai jis par
Maine woh saans bhi tere liye rakh chhodi hai, tujh pe ho jaaoonga qurbaan tujhe chaahoonga
couplets.en: Even the breath the world and its sorrows have some claim to, I have kept for you, my love, and would give it up for you.

lines: Apne jazbaat mein naghmaat rachaane ke liye
couplets.en: So I could give my feelings the shape of song.

lines: Apne jazbaat mein naghmaat rachaane ke liye
Maine dhadkan ki tarah dil mein basaaya hai tujhe
couplets.en: I made a home for you in my heart, close as its own beating, so my feelings could find their way into song.

lines: Apne jazbaat mein naghmaat rachaane ke liye
Maine dhadkan ki tarah dil mein basaaya hai tujhe
couplets.en: I made a home for you in my heart, close as its own beating, so my feelings could find their way into song.

lines: Main tasavvur bhi judaai ka bhala kaise karoon?
Maine qismat ki lakeeron se churaaya hai tujhe
couplets.en: How could I even imagine parting, when I stole you from the very lines of fate?

lines: Pyaar ka ban ke nigahbaan tujhe chaahoonga

lines: Teri har chaap se jalte hain khayaalon mein charaagh
couplets.en: At every footfall of yours, lamps come alight in my thoughts.

lines: Teri har chaap se jalte hain khayaalon mein charaagh
Jab bhi tu aaye jagaata hua jaadoo aaye
couplets.en: Your footsteps light lamps in my thoughts, and each time you come, a spell wakes with you.

lines: Teri har chaap se jalte hain khayaalon mein charaagh

lines: Tujhko chhoo loon to phir ai jaan-e-tamanna mujhko
Der tak apne badan se teri khushboo aaye
couplets.en: When I touch you, my heart's desire, your scent lingers on my skin.

lines: Tu bahaaron ka
couplets.en: You are of spring.

lines: Tu bahaaron ka hai unwaan tujhe chaahoonga
Main to mar kar bhi meri jaan tujhe chaahoonga, zindagi mein to sabhi pyaar kiya karte hain
couplets.en: You are the name of spring, my love, and though everyone loves in life, I will love you even in death.

lines: Main to mar kar bhi meri jaan tujhe chaahoonga
Zindagi mein to sabhi pyaar kiya karte hain
couplets.en: I will love you even in death, my love, as everyone loves while they live.
